verdict.rationale: Codegen shows a pre-implementation plan (codegen-docs-22) and lets you pull agent branches/changes locally via CLI (codegen-docs-13) before merging, and agents can create PRs directly (codegen-docs-24), but there is no documented explicit 'approve diff before PR creation' gate — PR creation appears to happen automatically as part of the agent workflow rather than after a human diff-approval step. Missing for 10: a documented review/approval UI or workflow step that gates PR creation on human diff approval, and evidence of how a rejected diff is handled before PR submission.
